import sys

def is_possible(S, P):
    if len(P) != 2 * len(S):
        return False
    for i in range(len(S) + 1):
        if P[:i] + S + P[i+len(S):] == P:
            return True
    return False

input = sys.stdin.read().split()
T = int(input[0])
index = 1
results = []
for _ in range(T):
    S = input[index]
    P = input[index + 1]
    index += 2
    results.append("Possible" if is_possible(S, P) else "Impossible")

print("\n".join(results))
